_comment: Deterministic harness config: renders a bundled test-pattern PNG (the path is relative to this plugin's own directory, which is the only base that holds however the plugins directory is named -- 'plugins/...' assumed one particular --plugin-dir and silently missed on a rig using plugin-repos/, leaving the render blank and every golden 'drifting'). fit_to_display scales the 64x32 pattern to each panel deterministically.
